title: Limits of heralded photonic Bell-state generation in the presence of loss
summary: High-quality entangled states of photons underlie quantum information science (QIS) applications across communication, sensing, and computing. In many discrete-variable photonic QIS architectures, large application-ready states (e.g., cluster states, repeater graph states) are constructed via fusion measurements on small entangled seed states, of which Bell states are the fundamental example.
